onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to the first scanner trigger pulse.

trial_type.Description: Type of scene presented during the trial - what the participant was looking at when this event began.

Levels.city: City scene. Frequent stimulus (~90% trials) - participant should press the response button.
Levels.mountain: Mountain scene. Infrequent stimulus (~10% trials) - participant should withhold the response button.

scene_num.Description: Numeric identifier of the scene presented during the trial.

scored_scene.Description: Scene category used to determine the correct response for the trial. It reflects the scene type of the following trial (and can differ from the trial_type of the row).

Levels.mountain: Mountain scene; participant should withhold responding.

outcome.Description: Outcome of the trial based on the presented scene and the participant's response.

Levels.hit: A response was made to a city scene.
Levels.correct_rejection: No response was made to a mountain scene.
Levels.commission_error: A response was made to a mountain scene.
Levels.omission_error: No response was made to a city scene.

response_time.Description: Reaction time from scene onset to the participant's scored response. n/a when no scored response was recorded.

pct_morph_at_response.Description: Percentage of image morphing completed at the time of the participant's scored response. n/a if no response was attributed to this trial.

attribution.Description: Indicates how the scored response was attributed to the trial.

Levels.own_trial: The response was attributed to the same trial in which it occurred.
Levels.reattributed_from_following_trial: The response was attributed to the current trial based on a response occurring during the following trial.
Levels.n/a: No response occurred during the trial or the following trial, so no response could be attributed.

trial_num.Description: Sequential trial number within the GradCPT task.

block_num.Description: Block number within the GradCPT task.

raw_press_1_time.Description: Time of the participant's first recorded button press relative to the beginning of the trial. n/a if no response was recorded in this slot.

raw_press_1_pct_morph.Description: Percentage of image morphing completed at the time of the participant's first recorded button press. n/a if no response was recorded in this slot.

raw_press_2_time.Description: Time of the participant's second recorded button press relative to the beginning of the trial. n/a if no response was recorded in this slot.

raw_press_2_pct_morph.Description: Percentage of image morphing completed at the time of the participant's second recorded button press. n/a if no response was recorded in this slot.

raw_press_3_time.Description: Time of the participant's third recorded button press relative to the beginning of the trial. n/a if no response was recorded in this slot.

raw_press_3_pct_morph.Description: Percentage of image morphing completed at the time of the participant's third recorded button press. n/a if no response was recorded in this slot.
